architecture.mechanism: Energy substitution — replacing depletable fossil-fuel energy with clean, externally supplied renewable energy rather than assuming self-generated, limitless on-board energy.
architecture.intervention: Redesign the water-powered car as an externally energized hydrogen vehicle: water is split off-board into hydrogen and oxygen using metered clean energy (solar/wind), the car stores and combusts/fuel-cells that hydrogen, and no claim is made of continuous operation from a single glass of water alone; an energy ledger accounts for every joule of input.
architecture.expected_effect: The first-law violation disappears because all motive output is traceable to metered external clean energy input; "infinite mileage" is reframed as a finite range bounded by the stored hydrogen's energy content, and the device becomes thermodynamically auditable.
architecture.falsification_test: Run a sealed, instrumented drive-cycle test: log total external electrical energy used for electrolysis, hydrogen mass/energy stored, and wheel work output; if net output energy exceeds total input energy, or if the vehicle runs indefinitely with only an initial glass of water and no external input, the claim is falsified as a perpetual-motion/energy-conservation violation.
